
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/wuty/p/19137419" title="发布于 2025-10-12 23:04">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">记录一下 WPF进程 SendMessage 发送窗口消息进行进程间通信，存在进程权限无法接受消息的问题</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2>前言</h2>
<p>最近在接手一个同事写的WPF项目，是使用.NetFramwork 开发的，使用的进程间通信没有使用我们之前封装的基于WebSocket的封装组件的，而是使用Win32的方式：发送端用的Windows Api：SendMessage ，接受端使用的是 钩子监听windows 的消息回传。</p>
<p>相信很多做桌面应用的，这种通信应该都是很常用，并且见怪不怪的。可是可能很多没有注意到进程权限的情况，这种通信存在有坑，并且这个坑还埋的挺深的。</p>
<h2>遇到的问题</h2>
<p>由于该WPF的项目的启动方式存在很多方式，如果桌面点击的方式（普通权限的），右键管理员启动的方式（管理员权限的），开机自启的方式（System权限降权的方式，普通权限），OTA之后启动（管理员权限），这样就会出现该进程窗口可能启动后的权限是不可预见的，并且用户是可以随意的变更用户权限去启动。然而，在一次测试中，做了升级后，启用了该应用，其他跟它通信的进程就无法跟该进程通信的。很诡异，只要是OTA之后，其他进程就无法通信，开机之后（普通权限）就可以通信。观察了日志，又没有报什么异常。</p>
<h2>复现问题</h2>
<p>一、创建一个WPF消息 发送端</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> COPYDATASTRUCT

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] messageBytes = Encoding.Unicode.GetBytes(message + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\0</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>二、创建一个WPF 消息 的接收端</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>&lt;Window x:Class=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">FramworkReceieve.MainWindow</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> MainWindow.xaml 的交互逻辑
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">partial</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MainWindow : Window
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MainWindow()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            Loaded </span>+=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MainWindow_Loaded;
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">uint</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _customMessageId;

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HwndSource _hwndSource;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> MainWindow_Loaded(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            _customMessageId </span>= RegisterWindowMessage(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">MyApp</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取窗口句柄并添加消息钩子</span>
            _hwndSource = PresentationSource.FromVisual(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">as</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HwndSource;
            _hwndSource</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.AddHook(WndProc);
        }

        [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.ByValTStr, SizeConst </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">16</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> content;


        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> IntPtr WndProc(IntPtr hwnd, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> msg, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ref</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> handled)
        {


            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#region</span> CopyData

            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (msg ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> WM_COPYDATA)
            {
                COPYDATASTRUCT cds </span>= (COPYDATASTRUCT)Marshal.PtrToStructure(lParam, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(COPYDATASTRUCT));
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> receivedMessage =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Marshal.PtrToStringUni(cds.lpData);

                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.Dispatcher.Invoke(() =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                {
                    txtMessage.Text </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> receivedMessage;
                });

                handled </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            }

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#endregion</span>



            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> IntPtr.Zero;
        }


        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#region</span>  RegisterWindows<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

        [DllImport(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user32.dll</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, CharSet = CharSet.Auto, SetLastError = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">extern</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">uint</span> RegisterWindowMessage(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> lpString);


        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#endregion</span>

        {

        }
    }</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>三、结果</p>
<p>1、俩个都是管理员权限的，是可以接受到数据的</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1063618/202510/1063618-20251012224255538-1894148697.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>2、俩个进程都是普通权限的，是可以接受到数据</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1063618/202510/1063618-20251012224433940-1066462989.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;3、发送端是管理员权限，接收端是 普通权限，是可以接受到数据</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1063618/202510/1063618-20251012225623788-1062347477.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(255, 102, 0, 1)">4、发送端是普通权限，接收端是 管理员权限，是接受不到数据</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1063618/202510/1063618-20251012225806517-2004295125.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>&nbsp;总结：</h2>
<p>1、进程间通信，最好使用无权限限制的方案</p>
<p>2、使用ChangeWindowMessageFilterEx 进行权限过滤</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
